dialogue.origin: （こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. I look forward to our session today.)

dialogue.origin: （こんばんは。宜しくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you, I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。本日は相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。初めに、性別、年齢、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To start, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは　お願いします。女性40代、相談内容はなかなか就職が決まらない、です。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you. I'm a woman in my 40s, and my concern is that I'm having trouble finding a job.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。なかなか就職が決まらないのですね。どのくらいお決まりになられていないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. So, you're having trouble finding a job. How long have you been looking?

dialogue.origin: 今年の3月いっぱいで前いたパート先が休業になって、なかなかヘビーな環境だったので次はやりたい事がやれる環境を！とかいろいろ希望が高くなりすぎたのか、
dialogue.content: My previous part-time job closed at the end of March this year, and it was a pretty demanding environment. So this time, I was hoping for a workplace where I could do what I want to do! But maybe my expectations got too high...

dialogue.origin: かれこれ4月から20社くらいは検討して面接もしたり、少し働いてみるものの、理想と違って
dialogue.content: Since April, I’ve looked into about 20 companies, had interviews, and even tried working a little at some, but they weren’t what I had envisioned...

dialogue.origin: 今は業務委託や派遣登録して最低頂きたい給料をなんとか確保している感じです。
dialogue.content: Right now, I’m doing contract work and have registered with temp agencies, just managing to secure the minimum income I’d like.

dialogue.origin: 前のパー先はヘビーだったのですね、、そうでしたか。働きやすい環境を求めるがやはり理想とは違うのはつらいですね。
dialogue.content: So your previous part-time job was tough... I see. It must be difficult to be looking for a comfortable work environment only to find that reality doesn't meet your ideals.

dialogue.origin: 給料などは何とか確保できているが、正社員とし働きやすい環境で働きたいという思いでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, while you've managed to secure an income, are you hoping to find a full-time position in a pleasant work environment?

dialogue.origin: 組織で働くのはもういいかなーとか。スキルアップして時給を上げていきたいのですが、現実はそうでなく…
dialogue.content: I’m starting to feel I might be done with working in organizations. I’d like to build my skills and raise my hourly wage, but in reality, it hasn’t worked out that way…

dialogue.origin: 正社員は今のところ考えてなくて、子供が小さいうち、あと２年くらいは現場は4〜5時間で十分だと思ってます。あまり8時間労働はしたくありません…
dialogue.content: I’m not considering a full-time position at the moment. While my child is still small—for the next two years or so—I think 4–5 hours on-site is enough. I don’t really want to work eight-hour days…

dialogue.origin: 現実はそううまくいかないと感じているのですね。そうですね。お子さんのことも考えると8時間働くのはなかなかハードですね。
dialogue.content: So you feel that things aren’t going so smoothly in reality. That makes sense. Considering your child, working eight hours a day would be quite demanding.

dialogue.origin: 去年までいたところも月70時間程度で扶養内ギリギリの収入を頂けたので、最低そのラインか、時給をもっと上げて扶養を外して稼ぎたいと思うようになり。
dialogue.content: At the job I had until last year, I worked about 70 hours a month and earned just enough to stay within the tax-exempt dependent status. So now, I want to earn at least that much, or ideally, get a higher hourly wage and earn enough to go beyond the dependent status threshold.

dialogue.origin: 贅沢な悩みに聞こえるかもしれませんが、、、
dialogue.content: This might sound like a luxury problem, but…

dialogue.origin: 自分をもっと活かしたい、そんな環境を作りたいという気持ちが強くなっていて、
dialogue.content: The desire to make better use of my skills and create that kind of environment for myself has been growing stronger,

dialogue.origin: でも正社員で8時間枠にハマって働くのは嫌になるだろうし。ただの愚痴ですみません…
dialogue.content: but I know I'd hate being boxed into an eight-hour, full-time role. I'm sorry, this is just me venting…

dialogue.origin: 家族のためにも、自分のためにもと考えられている方だなと感じます。ではこの二年以内の間で、スキルアップを望み時給を少しでも上げれたらいいなという思いでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I get the sense that you're someone who thinks about both your family and yourself. So, is it that within the next two years, you're hoping to improve your skills and raise your hourly wage, even just a little?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。在宅でできる仕事も増やしていけたらなーとか。
dialogue.content: That's right. And I'm thinking it would be nice if I could increase my remote work options as well.

dialogue.origin: これ、愚痴なんですけど、ちょっと聞いてほしくて、
dialogue.content: This is just me venting, but I really wanted you to hear me out.

dialogue.origin: 確かに子育てや家のことをこなしながら、8時間しっかり働いていくのもしんどいと感じます。どうされましたか？
dialogue.content: I can certainly see how balancing childcare and household duties while working a full eight hours would be exhausting. What's on your mind?

dialogue.origin: こないだここだ！と思えた会社があって、今までにない時給提示だったので、スキルアップできると思って面接して採用されたのですが、
dialogue.content: The other day, I found a company that felt like, “This is it!” The hourly rate they offered was unlike anything I’d seen before, so I thought I could really build my skills there. I interviewed and was hired, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 初めて頂いた仕事が、その時給で働くものではなく。私看護師なんですが、家政婦として、と言われて。どうしても納得いかず、結局断りました…
dialogue.content: The first job they gave me wasn't for that hourly wage. I'm a nurse, but they told me it was to work as a housekeeper. I just couldn't accept that, so in the end, I turned it down…

dialogue.origin: ただのプライドが高くて使いづらい人になってしまったような、馬鹿にされたような、なんかモヤモヤイライラが止まらなくて。
dialogue.content: I feel like I've just become a difficult person with too much pride, or like I was being made a fool of. This vague feeling of frustration and irritation just won't stop.

dialogue.origin: どう思います？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、確かに家政婦としてというと全く別の仕事にもなっていくと思います。相談者様が思う仕事内容からは遠くなる一方だと感じました。
dialogue.content: I see. Being asked to work as a housekeeper certainly sounds like a completely different job. I can imagine it felt like it was moving further and further away from the kind of work you had in mind.

dialogue.origin: そのようにイライラが出てしまうのですね。その職場は少し働いてからお辞めになったということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, so it's making you feel irritated. Did you work there for a little while before you quit?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね…看護師としては生きていたいとは思っていますし、ただ現場の仕事だけでは20〜30年後に繋がらないので今模索中なんです。
dialogue.content: Right... I do want to continue my career as a nurse, but I don't think on-site work alone will lead anywhere in 20 or 30 years, so I'm trying to figure things out right now.

dialogue.origin: 初めて依頼された家政婦の仕事は断って、保育園看護師の仕事は単発ではありますが数回月に頂けて、今月から始めました。
dialogue.content: I turned down the first housekeeping job they offered, but I was able to get some one-off shifts as a nursery school nurse a few times a month, and I started this month.

dialogue.origin: 業務委託なので、個人事業主扱いですね。なので派遣と掛け持ちして働いてます。
dialogue.content: It's contract-based, so I'm treated as a sole proprietor. That's why I'm juggling it with work from a temp agency.

dialogue.origin: 模索中ということですが、看護師として現場以外の仕事をということでしょうか？そうなのですね。今月から単発ではあるがはじめられたのですね。
dialogue.content: You mentioned you're trying to figure things out; does that mean you're looking for non-clinical work as a nurse? I see. So you started with some one-off shifts this month.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。別でも良いかなとは思っています。なんか、看護師のマイナスイメージとかを変えていきたくて。
dialogue.content: Yes. I’m open to something different as well. I want to help change some of the negative images people have of nurses.

dialogue.origin: 自分の掲げる理想が大きくなりすぎて、現状との乖離に疲れてきました。
dialogue.content: My ideals have gotten so big that the gap with reality is wearing me out.

dialogue.origin: 少しお返事しにくい状況でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it perhaps difficult for you to respond right now?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。何か質問されてましたかすみません！
dialogue.content: I'm okay. I'm sorry, did you ask me something?

dialogue.origin: 返事が来て安心しました。もう一度送りますね。
dialogue.content: I’m relieved to hear back from you. I’ll send it again.

dialogue.origin: はいすみません
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: 先ほど模索中といっていましたが、看護師としてこれから先は、現場職以外のことをしたいということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned earlier that you were trying to figure things out. As a nurse, does this mean you want to do something other than clinical work in the future?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 現場は半分くらい…が今のところ丁度いい感じです。
dialogue.content: About half my time in a clinical setting... that feels just right for now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。現場としては今のところがいい感じだと思われているのですね。
dialogue.content: Thank you. So for your on-site work, the current balance feels right to you for now.

dialogue.origin: 現場以、どのようなことがしたいなどあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Outside of clinical work, is there anything specific you'd like to do?

dialogue.origin: 現場以外となると、です。
dialogue.content: That is, besides clinical work.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。教育現場も4社検討して2社採用されたのですが、時給が伸びていかないし、きっと悶々する自分が数年後いるだろうなーと予想がついて、やめました。
dialogue.content: Let’s see. I also looked into four positions in education and was hired by two, but the hourly pay wouldn’t grow, and I could just see myself stewing about it a few years down the line, so I turned them down.

dialogue.origin: 今ある組織や仕事では、なかなか理想とするものがない、という感じです…
dialogue.content: It feels like among the organizations and jobs available now, there's nothing that really matches my ideals...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。なかなか理想に出会うというのが難しいですよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. It can be difficult to find something that meets your ideals, can't it...

dialogue.origin: 現在の職場の雰囲気など、働きやすさなどはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How are the atmosphere and ease of working in your current workplaces?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよねー。なんか20代の時はがむしゃらに修行だと思って出来たことが、今はできないやらないやりたくない、になってしまって。
dialogue.content: Exactly. In my 20s, I saw it as a form of training and could just push through things, but now it's become "I can't, I won't, and I don't want to."

dialogue.origin: 今のところは保育園は癒しなので好きです。会社自体は看護師を家政婦として働かせる感じなので一歩引いて、今は見ています。
dialogue.content: For now, I like the nursery school—it’s soothing. As for the company itself, since they seem to want nurses to work as housekeepers, I’m taking a step back and just observing for the moment.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、、そのように思われるのも職場の働きやすさなど、雰囲気などからの影響でしょうか、、
dialogue.content: I see... Do you think those feelings are influenced by the comfort and atmosphere of the workplace?

dialogue.origin: なるほど、様子見という形ですね。
dialogue.content: I understand. You’re taking a wait-and-see approach.

dialogue.origin: 家政婦も介護職も看護師も同じ時給で扱われたり、他職種連携でそれぞれの強みを活かす風土なら納得なのですが違うようなので。
dialogue.content: If housekeepers, caregivers, and nurses were all treated with the same hourly wage, or if there was a culture of interdisciplinary collaboration that utilized each person's strengths, I could accept it, but it doesn't seem to be like that.

dialogue.origin: けっこう看護師として扱われないことにショックでした…
dialogue.content: I was quite shocked at not being treated as a nurse…

dialogue.origin: このプライドを超えられない感じ…甘いですかね…
dialogue.content: This feeling of not being able to get over my pride... Am I being naive?

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。特に納得できない部分があるのですね。家政婦として扱われていることですかね、、
dialogue.content: I see. So there's a part of it you particularly can't accept. Is it being treated as a housekeeper?

dialogue.origin: 看護師なので、看護師として扱われないというのは腹立たしいことだと感じます。
dialogue.content: As a nurse, not being treated as one would understandably be frustrating.

dialogue.origin: はい、看護師としては必要とされず、ひたすらご飯作りをしてこいという指示で。私じゃなくて良くない⁈って思ってしまって。
dialogue.content: Yes. I wasn’t needed as a nurse; the instruction was simply to go and cook meals. I couldn’t help but think, “Does it really have to be me?”

dialogue.origin: そうですね。看護師らしい仕事が回ってこないという状況なのですね、、
dialogue.content: I see. So you’re not being given any nursing-type work.

dialogue.origin: それでも、保育園の子供たちが癒しだと、自分の頑張れる源を作れているというのは相談者様自身前を向けていると感じました。いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Even so, I feel that by finding comfort in the children at the nursery school and creating a source of motivation for yourself, you are managing to look forward. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: でも伺う先には看護師だと紹介するらしく。看護師がご飯を作りに来るって、何か違和感です。私が客側なら、この看護師は看護師がやれず家政婦をやっているのか、と感じてしまいます。保育園は望みで、頑張っていこうと思ってはいます。そろそろ時間ですよね。今日はひたすら愚痴ですみませんでした。
dialogue.content: But apparently, they introduce me as a nurse to the clients. A nurse coming to cook meals... it just feels strange. If I were the client, I would think, "Is this nurse working as a housekeeper because she can't make it as a nurse?" The nursery school is my hope, and I do intend to keep trying my best there. It's about time, isn't it? I’m sorry for just venting today.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、周りからもどう思われるかという不安もあると思います。そろそろお時間ですね。ここまでお話しされていかがだったでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand—I imagine there’s also the worry of how others might perceive it. It is about time to wrap up. How was it for you to talk through all of this today?

dialogue.origin: はい、初めて愚痴ってみました…なかなかスッキリはしないですが聞いて頂いてありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, this was the first time I've vented like this... I don't feel completely relieved, but thank you for listening.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。話足りない部分もあると思います。ぜひまた相談に来てください。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'm sure there are still things you want to talk about. Please feel free to come back for another session.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。評価の方もよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. I would appreciate your feedback as well.)

topic.sub: 看護師として理想の職場に出会えない問題
